build_shufflenetv1_backbone: build a ShuffleNetV1 backbone model with configurable groups and widen_factor for image feature extraction
create_shuffleunit_block: create a ShuffleUnit block with grouped 1x1 convolutions and channel shuffle for efficient feature transformation
build_shufflenet_layer: build a ShuffleNet layer by stacking ShuffleUnit blocks with concat or add combination modes
freeze_shufflenet_stages: freeze specific stages of the ShuffleNetV1 backbone to prevent gradient updates during training
initialize_shufflenet_weights: initialize ShuffleNetV1 convolution and batch normalization weights with normal and constant initialization
